meta_desc: Pinnacle EDS designs and implements the clinical, educational, and policy systems that health systems, school districts, and governments use to deliver consistent special education and ABA services.
og_desc: Clinical, educational, and policy systems for institutions delivering special education at scale.
hero_lede: We design and implement the clinical, educational, and policy systems that health systems, school districts, and governments use to deliver consistent care at scale.
serve_h2: Systems, not advice, for organizations operating at scale.
serve_lede: Our work is built for institutions where consistency across sites, schools, or an entire country determines whether a child receives quality care.
t1_p: Standardized ABA and special education clinical infrastructure across every location, from treatment planning to supervision and documentation.
t2_p: Program design, IEP infrastructure, compliance frameworks, and educator workforce development for large public systems.
t3_p: National policy frameworks, workforce pipelines, and implementation for governments building or reforming special education, including across the Gulf region.
appr_h2: From assessment to independence, in five phases.
appr_lede: Every engagement follows the same disciplined path and ends with infrastructure your teams can run without us.
s1_p: Audit of current systems, compliance posture, and gaps, with a prioritized roadmap.
s2_p: Frameworks, clinical standards, and policy documents built for your scale.
s3_p: Hands-on rollout across your organization or ministry.
s4_p: Workforce development so your teams operate the system independently.
s5_p: Advisory, compliance monitoring, and system evolution over time.
appr_note: All engagements are governed by our Institutional Implementation Methodology (IIM), which defines phased delivery, governance, risk management, and long-term sustainability.
fw_lede: Each framework is a defined engagement built from our team's clinical and educational leadership experience.
g1_sub: For health systems and multi-site ABA providers.
g2_sub: For state agencies, districts, and training pipelines.
cia_d: An organizational audit of program design, documentation, scheduling, supervision, and compliance.
isf_d: Consistent treatment plan development, goal architecture, and program design across every clinician and location.
sds_d: A scheduling and delivery method that targets, tracks, and executes clinical goals within every session.
mqas_d: Standardized documentation, supervisory review, and clinical auditing across locations and jurisdictions.
sesra_d: Evaluation of infrastructure, workforce capacity, and compliance alignment ahead of systemic reform.
nwdf_d: Training pipelines from foundational educator competencies to advanced practitioner and train-the-trainer programs.
grpa_d: Review of policy, infrastructure gaps, and workforce readiness, with a pathway to national implementation.
lead_h2: Founded by practitioners who have run these systems.
lead_p1: Pinnacle EDS was established in 2026 by three leaders in special education and applied behavior analysis, each with institutional leadership experience across clinical networks, school districts, and school-based programs.
lead_p2: Together the team brings more than 80 years of experience, including 30+ years in executive education leadership.

a11y_meta: Accessibility commitment and contact information for Pinnacle EDS.
a11y_lede: Pinnacle EDS is committed to making this website usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.
a11y_li1: Every page can be used with a keyboard alone, with visible focus indicators.
a11y_li2: Pages use headings and landmarks so screen reader users can navigate easily.
a11y_li3: Text and controls meet minimum color contrast ratios, and text can be enlarged without losing content.
a11y_li4: Images have text alternatives, and forms have clear labels and messages.
a11y_li5: The site is offered in several languages, with a right-to-left layout for Arabic.
a11y_limits: The leadership photo contains text that is part of the image, so the same information is given in its alternative text. Some translations are drafts that are still being reviewed by native speakers.
a11y_feedback: If you have trouble using any part of this site, or need information in another format, email info@pinnacleeds.com. Please describe the page and the problem. We aim to respond within five business days.
